description:
Is anything wrong with the Ollama calls your client sent through LLMxRay on port 11435? A verdict judged over several turns: a prompt rejected or silently cut by the context, the cache lost on every turn or on one turn, a model partly on CPU, tool schemas crowding the prompt.
Four tools read your turns, one question each: diagnose_my_turns, is anything wrong (a verdict over several turns); read_my_last_turn, what exactly happened on the latest turn (one turn in full); list_my_turns, what happened turn by turn (the sequence, one line each); compare_my_turns, did a change help (before against after).
Call it after a few turns, and again after a change. For which model or context fits use list_local_models.
Returns text. First one line per client seen, then one finding per line tagged [high], [medium] or [low], each ending with the fix. It says so when nothing stands out, and explains how to route through 11435 when no turn was seen.
client: your X-LLMxRay-Client name; without it on a shared machine you read every tool's turns. since_minutes: 1 to 10080, minutes since your change. They combine.
Needs LLMxRay running (npx llmxray) and says so if not. Under a second, from records already kept. No model is called.

client.description: Part of the client label or id as LLMxRay shows it (for example "VS Code Copilot", "python-requests", or the X-LLMxRay-Client header you sent). Case-insensitive substring. Omit for all clients.

since_minutes.description: Only turns from the last N minutes. Omit for every turn LLMxRay has kept.

name: diagnose_my_turns
title: Diagnose my turns
